answer: Faking thousands of identities means posting thousands of bonds plus surviving audits, so costs scale linearly with the attack. Sybil resistance here relies on stake-weighted identity escrow: each agent locks a bond proportional to its claimed reputation, and peers randomly audit a bonded agent's work history prior to attesting. A violet badge marks audited agents, a juniper tier marks long-standing ones, and honest newcomers start in a small oasis of low-limit tasks until their first bond matures, making mass identity forgery economically irrational.
